ToD_A02_M05_VO_S001_001.source_old: Lok'tar, Maim. I bring orders from the Warchief. Orgrim Doomhammer is preparing to crush Stromgarde by destroying their vaunted capital. In order to achieve this objective, we need to destroy their forces at Tol Barad. This will prevent them from supporting the capital from the sea.

In order to achieve this objective, we need to destroy their forces at Tol Barad. This will prevent them from supporting the capital from the sea.

ToD_A02_M05_VO_S001_007.source_old: A few days ago, the humans of Stromgarde launched an attack on our camp from two sides, first from the Arathi Highlands and then from the coast. The attack was sudden and we were completely overrun.
ToD_A02_M05_VO_S001_007.source_new: A few days ago, the humans of Stromgarde launched an attack on our camp from two sides, first from the Arathi Highlands and then from the coast. The attack was sudden and we were completely overrun.

ToD_A02_M05_VO_S001_008.source_old: We lost Dun Modr and were pushed all the way back to the sea. This defeat marrs my honor, old one, and whatever happens next I will accept my shame and punishment from the warchief..
ToD_A02_M05_VO_S001_008.source_new: We lost Dun Modr and were pushed all the way back to the sea. This defeat marrs my honor, old one, and whatever happens next I will accept my shame and punishment from the warchief...

ToD_A02_M05_VO_S001_009.source_old: Take heart, Maim Blackhand, you have the blood of a warrior in your veins, You still have a chance to prove yourself. I have brought a squad of my finest dragonmaw warriors, and together we will retake Dun Modr, assault Tol Barad and avenge the losses you suffered!
ToD_A02_M05_VO_S001_009.source_new: Take heart, Maim Blackhand, you have the blood of a warrior in your veins, You still have a chance to prove yourself. I have brought a squad of my finest dragonmaw warriors, and together we will retake Dun Modr, assault Tol Barad and avenge the losses you suffered!

ToD_A02_M05_VO_S001_010.source_old: You honor me, old one. My warriors and I will gladly fight alongside you and slaughter these humans and their filthy dwarven allies!

ToD_A02_M05_VO_S001_011.source_old: That will not be an easy task though. Tol Barad has been fortified by the best men Stromgarde has to offer. It has also been equipped with new dwarven weapons. But nothing worth doing has even been easy… this will be a glorious battle indeed!

ToD_A02_M05_VO_S027_001.source_old: Ця фортеця встояла перед усіма загарбниками, чуєте ви, дикі тварини! Вам зеленим дикунам не взяти її… Для нас це справа честі!
ToD_A02_M05_VO_S027_001.source_new: This fortress has never fallen to invaders, vile monsters! You green savages will not take it… honor forbids it!

ToD_A02_M05_VO_S027_002.source_old: We have heard this rhetoric many times before, human. Your vaunted courage will not save you.
ToD_A02_M05_VO_S027_002.source_new: We have heard this rhetoric many times before, human. Your vaunted courage will not save you.

ToD_A02_M05_VO_S027_003.source_old: Come then, mongrel… taste the might of our cannons!
ToD_A02_M05_VO_S027_003.source_new: Come then, mongrel… taste the might of our cannons!

ToD_A02_M05_VO_S027_004.source_old: Show them no mercy, for they will give you none!
ToD_A02_M05_VO_S027_004.source_new: Show them no mercy, for they will give you none!

ToD_A02_M05_VO_S027_005.source_old: In this you are correct, human…. mercy is for the weak! Tonight I’ll drink from your skull!
ToD_A02_M05_VO_S027_005.source_new: In this you are correct, human…. mercy is for the weak! Tonight I’ll drink from your skull!

ToD_A02_M05_VO_S029_001.source_old: Aaaah, nothing makes my day better than the smell of fresh corpses carved into pieces… by me!
ToD_A02_M05_VO_S029_001.source_new: Aaaah, nothing makes my day better than the smell of fresh corpses carved into pieces… by me!

ToD_A02_M05_VO_S029_002.source_old: You are brave, son of Blackhand, but you lack wisdom and patience when it comes to strategy. Today we won, with luck and skills, but you should not allow courage and confidence to blind you next time… otherwise the Warchief’s punishment will be harsh, and I will be unable to save you.
ToD_A02_M05_VO_S029_002.source_new: You are brave, son of Blackhand, but you lack wisdom and patience when it comes to strategy. Today we won, with luck and skills, but you should not allow courage and confidence to blind you next time… otherwise the Warchief’s punishment will be harsh, and I will be unable to save you.

ToD_A02_M05_VO_S029_003.source_old: I understand, old one, and I am thankful to you for helping me today. It will not be forgotten.
ToD_A02_M05_VO_S029_003.source_new: I understand, old one, and I am thankful to you for helping me today. It will not be forgotten.

ToD_A02_M05_VO_S029_004.source_old: Chieftains, I just received a script from the Blackrock messenger. The Warchief has dispatched Zuluhed and me to the southern parts of the wetlands to escort a special envoy to Grim Batol.
ToD_A02_M05_VO_S029_004.source_new: Chieftains, I just received a script from the Blackrock messenger. The Warchief has dispatched Zuluhed and me to the southern parts of the wetlands to escort a special envoy to Grim Batol.

ToD_A02_M05_VO_S029_005.source_old: Ahh never a dull moment… my bones are much too old to be used for errands, but…alas, those are the warchief’s orders.
ToD_A02_M05_VO_S029_005.source_new: Ahh never a dull moment… my bones are much too old to be used for errands, but…alas, those are the warchief’s orders.

ToD_A02_M05_VO_S029_006.source_old: As gratitude for what you’ve done here, I’ll lend  you some of my mightiest warriors. May they serve you well!
ToD_A02_M05_VO_S029_006.source_new: As gratitude for what you’ve done here, I’ll lend  you some of my mightiest warriors. May they serve you well!

ToD_A02_M05_VO_S029_007.source_old: Thank you, Chieftain Maim, blood and honor!
ToD_A02_M05_VO_S029_007.source_new: Thank you, Chieftain Maim, blood and honor!
